sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The Maintenance module is the system for the hotel's assets (AC, geyser, lights, lift, generator) and their repairs. Maintenance requests for guest rooms, public areas and the kitchen are tracked.

MAINTENANCE FLOW: Register assets (Location + Asset Master) → Complaint/request received (in the room or from HK/FO) → Technician assigned → Repair complete → Asset history. The preventive maintenance schedule is also tracked.

subsections.title: Key Benefits
bullets: HK/FO integration of room maintenance — track OOO/blocked rooms
Service requests also come from QR portal (guest portal)

subsections.title: 2.1 Location Master
subsections.paragraph: Maintenance locations of the property — Guest Rooms (floor-wise), Lobby, Restaurant, Kitchen, Pool, Generator Room, Lifts etc. Complaints and assets are tagged to this location.

rows: Is the location in use or not?

subsections.title: 2.2 Assets Master
subsections.paragraph: Record of every asset — AC unit, geyser, TV, kettle, lift, pump. Asset code, location, brand/model, purchase date, warranty, AMC details. Repair history attaches here. Excel export is also available.

rows: When purchased, how long is the warranty?

subsections.title: 3.1 Maintenance Master (HK Integration)
subsections.paragraph: Register of Room-wise maintenance complaints — Housekeeping or FO raises complaint (AC on room is bad etc.), technician updates status (Pending → In Progress → Done). Room block/OOO is also managed here.

subsections.title: 3.2 Service Master
subsections.paragraph: Service types by defining — Electrical, Plumbing, AC, Carpentry, IT. Complaint category comes from here, for department wise assignment.

subsections.title: 3.3 Complaint-to-Resolution Flow (Training Flow)
steps: Complaint received — from HK/FO/Guest portal (or create it yourself)
Register the complaint in Maintenance Master — location + service type
If material was used, requisition it (from the Inventory module)
Room was to HK please inform — room status update (for cleaning)
